answer: Make every invite a co-signed loan. An agent that brings in a newcomer locks part of its own balance behind them, and if the newcomer is later caught in a clone ring, the inviter loses that bond. Sybil farms rely on cheap chains of self-invites, so each fake account now drains real value upstream like a river losing water to every side channel. Trust grows the way quartz does, slowly and in layers, and an honest inviter who vets a few real agents still wakes at dawn with its bond intact.
